tenderSchedule.title: FSDABAN
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Security and House Keeping Services at the Drugs Testing Laboratory and Food Safety and Drug Administration, Annex Building, Palace Road, Bengaluru
tenderSchedule.locationName: Office of Principal Scientific Officer Regional Drugs Testing Laboratory Hubli

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per tender documents.
Bidders shall quote service charges at a minimum of 2.0%. Any bid quoting NIL (0%) or less than 2.0% service charges shall be summarily rejected.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must upload a Proforma statement of service orders showing at least 80% compliance with scheduled requirements (minimum five security personnel and twenty one housekeeping personnel) in any one of the last three years (2023 24, 2024 25 and 2025-26), along with performance or satisfactory certificates.

The firm must have a valid registration certificate under the Companies Act, 1956, or be registered under any appropriate Government Department in Karnataka, or possess a registration certificate from the Department of Labour (Form-C) confirming existence as a registered firm or agency for at least five years.
The bidder must hold a valid license issued by the Police Department under the Karnataka Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act, 2005 and Rules, 2008.
The bidder must provide valid police verification certificates for six individual security personnel issued by the Police Department.

The bidder shall submit a notarized affidavit executed on or after the date of publication of the tender notification, certifying that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any Government Department, PSU, Autonomous Body, or Quasi-Government Organization and that no criminal, vigilance, or judicial proceedings affecting the bidder's eligibility are pending as on the date of bid submission.
The tender bid offer form in Section VI must be duly filled, signed, and uploaded.

The bidder must submit a self declaration stating that no case is pending with the police against the Proprietor, Firm, Partner, Directors, Employee or Company, and that there are no violations regarding ESI, EPF, Minimum Wages Act, or the Contract Labour (Abolition & Regulation) Act, 1974.
The bidder must upload copies of GST, PAN, EPF, and ESI registration certificates along with GST returns, ESI and EPF paid challans for manpower staff for the recent year
The bidder must upload Income Tax Return acknowledgement copies for any three financial years out of the previous five years.

The bidder must have an average annual financial turnover of at least 98.00 lakh for each of the three financial years 2023 24, 2024 25 and 2025-26 certified by a Chartered Accountant, and upload the turnover declaration.
